problems.problem: The dawn tide-line material reads as three stacked bands instead of one continuous wet plane: a hard horizontal seam crosses the frame at ~y860 (behind the subtitle), a second darker crease line runs at ~y1200-1260 just below the bottle, and a speckled dry-sand strip occupies the bottom edge. The bottle therefore appears parked on a mid-frame shelf of grey water while前景 sand sits lower, breaking the single 'still water sheet' plane the concept requires; references 3-5 each show one coherent ground/space.

Contact detail (crop 484,1012-941,1262) confirms a contact shadow IS present at offset_y 0 directly under the base - correctly aligned, do not move down. However it renders as a thin hard dark slit (~x626-794) narrower than the visible glass footprint (~x569-849), so the base reads pinched onto a line rather than settled into wet sand. The brief's '倒影没入水面' mirror reflection is absent: only flat grey water surrounds the base, so the water narrative光源 is not delivered.

The left inscription column loses its vertical rhythm: logo baseline ~430 to title top 518 is an 88px gap, but title bottom 608 to subtitle top 893 is a 285px void, so 'EAU DE PARFUM' floats orphaned at mid-height instead of anchoring the column foot as briefed; the column no longer reads as one coastal-stele block beside the bottle.

The sand-gold divider line (decoration at x454,y490) renders as a ~2x10px speck between the columns - visible in the poster as a stray dot right of the title - rather than the intended vertical water-mark rule; it currently reads as a render artifact, not a grid device.

Lighting mismatch: the unmodified packshot carries soft diffuse frontal studio light with broad cap/shoulder highlights, but the backdrop's brightest zone is the upper sky and the water plane darkens toward the base, so the bottle's luminance sits above its surroundings without a supporting bounce; references 4-5 match subject and ground luminance deliberately.
